properties.name: MEASURED 2026-10-03 on CI: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_held_designs_read_is_as_true_as_the_live_one.rs (from #657) failed on main 72bf252 (run 37110378324, 1 case) and on PR #660 at 568739f (run 37113790872, 2 cases) with "the --serve-shared server never took the store" — its hold() waits 300 x 100 ms for a --call read to report SNAPSHOT — and passed on main 293f957 and on #660 at 8147105
properties.statement: OBSERVED: the panic at a_held_designs_read_is_as_true_as_the_live_one.rs:202, "the --serve-shared server never took the store", in different cases on different runs (a_copy_that_fails_part_way_leaves_nothing_behind on main 72bf252; a_held_read_answers_a_held_write_refuses_and_nothing_is_written_beside_the_store and a_held_design_written_by_a_newer_reflow2_is_refused_as_the_live_one_is on #660 568739f), while the same file passed on main 293f957 and 230008c and on #660 8147105. EXPECTED: the holder takes the store well inside the 30 s the probe allows, every run. PRECEDENT, not established as this cause: fact:the-first-open-after-an-upgrade-outran-the-30s-respawn-wait-and-the-error-blamed-a-lock-holder-2026-09-30 measured a store open outrunning a 30 s wait. NOT ESTABLISHED: why the holder is slow or absent on those runs — it was not root-caused here, because it is outside item 6 and the test's own code is #657's.
